tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi zhus lan bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad cing thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa de'i phyag tu spring ba/ khyed kyis spring ba'i yi ge de/ yig rten g.yu dang bcas par kho bo'i sug par legs par phyin/ de thugs la btags/ dri ba dang po/ khyod la mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ci yod zer ba la/ bdag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mos gus phyin ci ma log pa yod/ gsung rab kyi don la go ba cung zad tsam mchis/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyud las skyes pa tsam ni chen po mi bdog dri ba gnyis pa/ hor 'di la khyed kyis byon pas phan pa'i rgyu mtshan bdog gam zer ba la/ hor 'di nged la cis kyang mchod gnas la shog mi 'ong na dmag 'ong ngo zer bas/ dmag byung na bod la gnod kyis dgos nas 'gro ba lags/ sems can la phan du re nas 'gro ba ma gtogs pa phan nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ma mchis/ lar sems can la phan na rang gi lus srog gtong ba la mi phod rgyu mi bdog pa tsam shes par gda'/ dri ba gsum pa/ hor byung ba'i tshe/ mtshams las ma 'thon na bag med kyi spyod par 'gyur ram zer ba la/ khyed sgrub pa mdzad pa rjes su yi rang*/ bod spyi'i ngo blta btsan sa cig byung na dben par bzhugs pa 'thad/ de ma byung na btsan sa gzhan zhig tu byon nas sgrub pa bgyis pa 'thad dam sems/ dri ba bzhi pa/ nges 'byed la sogs pa'i yon tan ma skyes par lus la shig mi 'ong ba la skyon yon ci bdog zer ba la/ lus la shig mi 'ong ba khyed sgrub pa la brtson pa dang*/ bla ma bzang bas nges 'byed kyi rtags yin pa yang ma bkag de rang gis mi shes pa yin/ gang ltar na yang sdig pa dag pa'i rtags yin pa la the tshom med/ 'on kyang dga' mi dga' 'du shes gang yang mi bya/ thams cad 'khrul par shes par bya/ bsgom skyon thams cad des sel ba yin/

dri ba lnga pa/ dbang ma thob par rab gnas byar rung ngam zer ba la/ bum pa 'cha' ba dang dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la dbang bskur yang*/ gsang ba slob dpon gyi dbang cis kyang thob 'tshal/ bum pa mi 'cha' na gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu tsam la rab gnas su ming btags pa rgya gar na yang bdog pas bgyis pas mchi/ spyir ting nge 'dzin dgos/ dri ba drug pa/ gson po'i bum pa 'cha' ba gang nas bshad zer ba la/ gson po'i bum pa rgyud dang mi mthun/ sgrib pa sbyong ba tsam yin na mi 'gal/ gzhan du na gson po'i rnam shes la dgug thabs med/ dri ba bdun pa/ slob dpon zla grags slob dpon klu sgrub la slebs sam zer ba la/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa lags/ dgongs pa bskang ba'i slob ma yin pas klu sgrub slob ma zla grags zhes gsungs pa yin/ dri ba brgyad pa/ da bstan pa ci tsam zhig gnas zer ba la/ bstan pa'i babs la lhag pa shes rab song nas/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mjug tshul khrims kyi mgo zin tsam du mngon par gda'/ mdo la la'i lugs kyis rtags tsam 'dzin pa la thug par mngon/ lar da yun ring po mi bdog de'i mjug ci tsam gnas pa'i lon nye gnas 'di la bskur nas bdog dri ba dgu pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i skyed chog gi khyed ci ltar yin zer ba la/ gsang sngags spyi'i sgrub lugs la/ bya ba'i rgyud don zhags la sogs pa'i lugs kyis bris sku lhar bskyed nas/ rang tha mal gyi gtsang sbra dang*/ dka' thub kyis bris sku de rje dpon lta bu las bdag bran lta bus dngos grub len pa lags/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lugs kyis/ bdag kyang lhar bskyed/ bris sku yang lhar bskyed nas grogs po lta bu las dngos grub len pa lags/ de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lugs kyis/

gtsor rang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgoms nas/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dngos grub blangs nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol te/ bris sku la phyi'i dmigs pa'i rten tsam du byed pa lags/ dges rdor ram/ bde mchog gam/ gsang 'dus la sogs pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi lugs kyis rang lhar bskyed nas/ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su mi gsol bar/ snang ba thams cad lhar shes par byas nas bsgrub pa lags/ don zhags la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten nas bdag lhar bskyed pa bshad pa de rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lugs su bgyis par gda'/ de'i lugs la smyung gnas mi byed par snga dro yan chad dkar gsum la sogs pa za zhing byed pa lags/ dri ba bcu pa/ bsgom pa la sems la gol sa du yod zer ba la/ bsgom pa la spyir thos pa che na gol sa chung*/ thos pa chung na gol sa che/ bye brag sems bag chags kyi rjes su 'brang na byis pa ma rabs su gol/ sems log par bltas na mu stegs su gol/ sems 'gog pa nyan thos su gol/ sems gsal ba sems tsam du gol/ sems yan bar btang na phyal bar gol/ sems stong par bltas na chad par gol/ sems ther zug tu bltas na rtag par gol/ de bas na gang la yang mi gnas par bya/ mi gnas pa la mtshan ma mi skye/ mtshan ma ma skyes na las legs nyes kyi 'bras bu mi 'byin/ las legs nyes kyi 'bras bu ma phyung na khams gsum du skye ba mi yin/ khams gsum du skye ba ma blangs na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi myong*/ de la byang chub ces ming btags pa yin/ dri ba bcu gcig pa/ sems kyi ngo ji ltar sprod zer ba la/ kho bo'i lugs kyis sems la ngo bo med pas sprad rgyu mi bdog dran pa med cing yid la bya ba med pa ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa zhes ming du btags pa yin/ dri ba bcu gnyis pa/ sems kyi skye 'chi'i lugs ji ltar yin zer ba la/

don dam par sems la skye 'chi med/ tha snyad kun rdzob skye 'gag tu snang ba 'di thams cad 'khrul bar 'ong ba lags/ dri ba bcu gsum pa/ 'bri stag la sogs pa phyag rgya pa'i chos 'di nor ram ma nor zer ba la/ 'bri stag dang phyag rgya pa'i chos lugs 'di rgyud sde dang sde snod dang mthun mi mthun ci rigs par gda'/ 'di yang dag pa'i lam du 'gyur mi 'gyur khyed rang gis legs par dpyod/ dri ba bcu bzhi pa/ bslab bya'i gdams ngag cig gnang bar zhu zer ba la/ spyir 'dul ba spyi'i dam tshig pha rol tu phyin pa bye brag gi dam tshig gsang sngags khyad par gyi dam tshig bgyi pa yin pas/ 'o skol chos pa rnams kyi spyod pa 'dul ba dang mthun/ bsgom pa mdo sde dang mthun/ bshad pa mngon pa dang mthun/ gsang sngags byed na rgyud sde dang mthun pa cig dgos/ de tsho dang mi mthun pa'i chos pa bzang zer ba byung yang cir 'gro mi shes par gda'/ de tsho dang mthun na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa phyin ci ma log pa yin nam sems/ 'di rnams kyi rnam gzhag kho bos bgyis pa'i bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba la sogs pa rnams na cung zad gsal bar bdog pas de dag tu gzigs par zhu/ bla ma 'od 'jo ba chen po de'i brgyud pa/ rnam thar mdzad spyod la sogs pa kho bos kyang legs par khums/ skyon dang bral ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du snang*/ nged kyang dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam bka' srol cig la khyed kyi bla ma'am/ brgyud pa 'di la dad/ gzhan phal cher bsra bsrer snang*/ khyed kyang de lta bu la slob cing bsgrub pa mdzad pa la shin tu smon/ nged kyang khyed lta bu dang mjal bar mos pa lags te gser yig pa 'di rnams kyis bdas nas gzhan dbang du thal bas ma thon pa lags pas/ thugs kyis mi bas par gzung bar zhu/ khyed la na bza' gcig 'bul ba'i sha chags pa la/ nga cag gi gzhis ma thams cad phar khar thal 'gron lam lta bu lags pas rngo ma thogs/

yi ge mi 'khyar ba'i rten du dar 'di 'bul bas phyag tu bzhes par zhu/ chos kyi sku gcig tu ma gyur gyi bar du thugs rgyud gang mtho mthos 'dzin pa lags/ khyed kyi yi ge 'di mthong bas nan tar shes pa dga' bar byung*/ rjes su yi rang*/ shin tu bkra shis par smon/ dris lan rjes 'brel bde blag rtogs bgyi'i phyir// mtshams sbyor 'ga' zhig 'phags pas bris lags pa'i// nongs pa mchis gang thugs rje che bzod mdzod// dge bas chos don 'gro bas rtogs gyur cig// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
